verdict.rationale: Penpot documents APIs: a plugin API, access tokens for API access, webhooks and an MCP server. None of the evidence mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The axis applies to a design platform with public APIs, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
